title: ECMWF AIFS: the forecast of ECMWF's AI model AIFS Single, near the surface and aloft
provider: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF); open data of the Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System, AIFS Single (model aifs-single, stream oper), at 0.25°, from data.ecmwf.int
credit: ECMWF AIFS (CC BY 4.0): based on data and products of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF); sampled to 1°

mirrors.dataset: the copy on Amazon S3 (registry.opendata.aws/ecmwf-forecasts), in the same layout

variables.name: mtpr
variables.long_name: Precipitation rate, mean over the {interval} h before

cycle.description: The run taken is the latest at 00 or 12 UTC, at or before this time (UTC), whose files reach the last step; ECMWF keeps the last 12 runs (about three days)

hours.description: Last step, in hours after the run

step_hours.description: Hours between steps: a multiple of 6, the model's step

stride.description: Take every n-th point of the 0.25° grid when the product is built: 4 gives 1°, 8 gives 2° (the files hold the whole grid)

forecast.description: The latest run to five days ahead, every 6 h: 11 fields at 21 steps, about 105 MB of GRIB2; a 1° product

glance.description: The latest run to two days ahead, every 12 h: about 25 MB of GRIB2; a 2° product

format: GRIB2 with CCSDS packing, one file per step holding the selected messages in the order of the source file: msl (Pa); 2t (K); 10u, 10v (m s-1); tp (kg m-2, accumulated from the start of the run); t at 850 hPa (K); gh at 500 hPa (geopotential metres); u, v at 500 and 250 hPa (m s-1). Grid 0.25°, 1440 x 721, latitude 90° to −90°, longitude −180° to 179.75°. Decoded with ecCodes by data/products/ecmwf_fields.py.
coverage: Global; runs at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC, every 6 h to 360 h; the model runs on a reduced Gaussian grid (N320, about 31 km) and the files are interpolated to 0.25°; the last 12 runs are kept
